title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-02-05
source: Reel To Reel > CD Burner > Roxio Sound Editor > Wav > WavePad > Flac16

ai_review.summary: Crystal-clear audience recording of a vibrant show highlighted by a superb China Cat Sunflower, making it a must-download.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers gush over the surprisingly pristine sound of this audience tape—so clear they prefer it to the existing soundboard version. The performance is described as immersive and energetic from the opening China Cat Sunflower through the encore, with only brief banter interrupting an otherwise engaging set.

ai_rating.rationale: Two five‑star reviews consistently praise both the exceptional audio fidelity of the audience source and the high energy of the performance, justifying a near‑perfect rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Exceptionally clear for an audience tape; faint crowd ambience adds atmosphere while instruments remain crisp and well balanced—reviewers even favor it over a soundboard version.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong opening with China Cat Sunflower, sustained momentum throughout the set and encore, occasional brief interludes and banter that enhance rather than detract from the immersive experience.
